# `Q-5-40` — Algolia Search Is Misconfigured

> `website.search.algolia` needs `application-id`,
> `search-only-api-key`, and `index-name`. The Algolia settings are
> ignored and the built-in search index is used instead.

## What this means

Using Algolia as the search backend requires three values so the
browser can query your index:

```yaml
# _quarto.yml
website:
  search:
    algolia:
      index-name: my-site
      application-id: ABC123DEF4
      search-only-api-key: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
```

When one of them is missing, Quarto cannot build a working Algolia
client, so it warns and renders the site with its own Pagefind-based
search instead. Nothing else about the site changes. Quarto 1 emitted
the same warning but still wired the Algolia scripts, which left the
search box broken in the browser.

## How to fix it

Add the missing key, or remove the `algolia` block to use the built-in
search. The search-only API key is safe to publish; never use an admin
key here.
